comparison.objective: Candidate removes a fan; record fits a spin-on oil filter.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual latch-and-lift versus thread engagement and hand-controlled rotation through a specified post-contact angle.
comparison.success_condition: Fan safely removed versus filter tightened 240–360° past gasket contact by wrist motion, never detached or over-tightened, released for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Threaded sealing and angular force control are materially different from guided withdrawal.
